*Effective September 14, 2026. These terms cover slamdunk.bet and the picks, projections, and data published by Slam Dunk Betting Services LLC ("Slam Dunk Bets", "we").*

### What we are, and aren't

Slam Dunk Bets is an **information and entertainment service**. We publish sports betting projections, picks, and analysis. We are not a sportsbook, we do not accept or place wagers, and we never hold money on your behalf. Whether, where, and how much you bet is entirely your decision and your responsibility.

### Eligibility and legality

You must be **21 or older**, or the legal betting age in your jurisdiction if it's higher, to use our picks. Sports betting is not legal everywhere. It is your responsibility to know and follow the laws where you live and to use only licensed sportsbooks that are legal for you.

### No guarantees

Our picks are probabilistic. We publish every graded bet precisely because individual plays lose often, sometimes for long stretches, and long-run results come from many small edges. **Past performance does not guarantee future results.** Nothing on this site is financial advice, and you should never bet money you can't afford to lose.

### Responsible gambling

If gambling stops being fun, help is free and confidential: call or text **1-800-GAMBLER**, or visit the [National Council on Problem Gambling](https://www.ncpgambling.org/help-treatment/about-the-national-problem-gambling-helpline/). Most sportsbooks also offer deposit limits, time-outs, and self-exclusion.

Prices, free trials, renewals, cancellations, and refunds are handled through whichever platform you subscribed on; contact them first for billing questions.
